name: Gallows' End Tavern
summary: In Brill, Forsaken gather at Gallows' End Tavern for hospitality and fellowship. The town's principal inn offers shelter and spirits, with class mentors and trade instructors in its halls and covert interrogations below.

sections.title: A Gathering Place for the Dead
sections.body: Along Brill's road, Gallows' End Tavern gathers newly awakened Forsaken leaving Deathknell and traveling south toward the Undercity. Though undead, they come for fellowship, trade, and refuge. Class instructors guide young warriors, priests, mages, rogues, and warlocks. Vendors and medical practitioners are here as well.

sections.title: Secrets in the Cellar
sections.body: Beneath the tavern's floorboards, prisoners of war are bound and guarded out of public view. Among them are a captured Scarlet Zealot and a Dwarven Mountaineer. The Forsaken hold them for interrogation and experimentation as they fight to secure their borders against zealous crusaders and Alliance scouts.

faq.q: Where is the Gallows' End Tavern located?
faq.answer: Gallows' End Tavern stands in the center of Brill, the main Forsaken settlement in Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Undercity.

faq.q: Why do the undead need an inn or tavern?
faq.answer: The Forsaken need no sleep or mortal sustenance to survive, yet taverns preserve social bonds and habits from their past lives. Gallows' End also provides a secure civic center for training, commerce, and official business.

faq.q: Who is imprisoned in the basement?
faq.answer: In the cellars beneath Gallows' End Tavern, the Forsaken hold a Scarlet Zealot from the hostile Scarlet Crusade and an Alliance Dwarven Mountaineer.

faq.q: What services and trainers can be found here?
faq.answer: The tavern has instructors for warriors, priests, mages, rogues, and warlocks, as well as first aid and enchanting trainers, general trade vendors, and an innkeeper.

angles.text: As a newly awakened Forsaken, you find your first major inn beyond Deathknell at Gallows' End Tavern. It is a crossroads for entering the wider world.
Beneath the taproom, the Forsaken hold captured Alliance scouts and Scarlet Crusade zealots for intelligence and interrogation.
